description: Estilo Pixar 3D animado tipo frutinovela: celulas/personajes antropomorficos comicos, paleta naranja-rojo-dorado, efectos de fuego, tono dramatico-divertido. Aprendido del ad SuperCalm.

format.description: Gráficas con movimiento: micro-videos con cámara/objetos en movimiento (Veo/Higgsfield).

visualStyle.promptTemplate: 3D animated Pixar-style scene, DENSE and richly detailed with MANY components: a main anthropomorphic character surrounded by multiple small germ/cell creatures with expressive faces, set in a vivid body-interior environment (glowing blood vessels, floating cells, organic red-orange textures), layered depth, dramatic fire/energy effects, glowing orange-red-yellow palette, high contrast cinematic lighting, busy multi-character composition, menacing yet humorous tone. CLEAN of text overlays — text is rendered in post-production.
visualStyle.negativePrompt: realistic, photorealistic, dark, desaturated, minimalist, flat design, 2D, watercolor, pastel colors, cute, soft
visualStyle.styleBoilerplate: 3D animated Pixar-style character design, anthropomorphic inflammatory cells/bacteria with exaggerated comedic expressions, glowing orange-red-yellow color palette, dramatic fire/energy effects, high  Dominant palette: #FF6B35, #FFA500, #FFD700, #FF4500, #8B4513, #FFFFFF, #1A1A1A.
